decisions.decision: User approved session-scoring-v1 for end-to-end implementation: session target selection, optional private bets on the existing ballot, personal vote/bet/streak/bluff score breakdown, session standings, final standings and explicit fresh-session reset. Reuse existing palette, buttons, avatars, selection springs, score animation and restrained final confetti. Target settings save into the existing lobby readiness flow.

User approved clue-board-v2: optional clue history by player and clue turn, host-controlled further turns or immediate voting, one-field editor, all-turn history read-only in voting/runoff. Preserve existing charcoal/ivory/sage/lime tokens, avatars, roster dividers, ballot rows, and motion sheet.
User approved all six proposal-v1 image boards; preserve screen interiors and the documented motion.

User approved topic-voting-v1: multi-select approval ballots before every round, hidden tallies until all submit, uniform tied-leader draw, public chosen-topic card. Reuse the existing tile/check/progress components and palette.
